description: This file contains utility functions for exporting note data, including determining note format, filename, and creating blobs with appropriate MIME types, specific to note processing in a web application.

methods.name: getNoteFormat
methods.description: Determines the format of a note based on its type and user preferences.

methods.name: getNoteFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the note based on its title and format.

methods.name: getNoteBlob
methods.description: Creates a Blob object containing the note content with an appropriate MIME type based on format.

ctags.name: getNoteFileName
ctags.pattern: /^export const getNoteFileName = (application: WebApplication, note: SNNote): string => {$/
